mapper.sql: id, employee_id, salary_month, emp_name, dept_name, post_name, base_salary, post_salary, perf_salary, overtime_pay, attendance_deduct, gross_pay, social_personal, fund_personal, tax, net_pay, remark, create_time, update_time, is_deleted
mapper.select: SELECT e.name AS empName, d.dept_name AS deptName, p.post_name AS postName FROM hr_employee e LEFT JOIN hr_department d ON e.dept_id = d.id LEFT JOIN hr_position p ON e.post_id = p.id WHERE e.id = #{employeeId} AND e.is_deleted = 0

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(overtime_hours), 0) AS overtimeHours, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'LATE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS lateCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'EARLY' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS earlyCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'ABSENT' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS absentCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'LEAVE' AND leave_type = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS shijiaCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'LEAVE' AND leave_type = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS bingjiaCount FROM hr_attendance WHERE employee_id = #{employeeId} AND DATE_FORMAT(attend_date, '%Y-%m') = #{month} AND is_deleted = 0
SELECT FROM hr_payroll WHERE employee_id = #{employeeId} AND salary_month = #{salaryMonth} AND is_deleted = 0
SELECT FROM hr_payroll WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO hr_payroll (employee_id, salary_month, emp_name, dept_name, post_name, base_salary, post_salary, perf_salary, overtime_pay, attendance_deduct, gross_pay, social_personal, fund_personal, tax, net_pay, remark) VALUES (#{employeeId}, #{salaryMonth}, #{empName}, #{deptName}, #{postName}, #{baseSalary}, #{postSalary}, #{perfSalary}, #{overtimePay}, #{attendanceDeduct}, #{grossPay}, #{socialPersonal}, #{fundPersonal}, #{tax}, #{netPay}, #{remark})
mapper.update: UPDATE hr_payroll SET employee_id = #{employeeId}, salary_month = #{salaryMonth}, emp_name = #{empName}, dept_name = #{deptName}, post_name = #{postName}, base_salary = #{baseSalary}, post_salary = #{postSalary}, perf_salary = #{perfSalary}, overtime_pay = #{overtimePay}, attendance_deduct = #{attendanceDeduct}, gross_pay = #{grossPay}, social_personal = #{socialPersonal}, fund_personal = #{fundPersonal}, tax = #{tax}, net_pay = #{netPay}, remark = #{remark} WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0
UPDATE hr_payroll SET is_deleted = 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0
UPDATE hr_payroll SET emp_name = #{empName} WHERE employee_id = #{employeeId} AND is_deleted = 0
